description: Use this when someone wants to plan posts around festivals and holidays in Malaysia, Canada or Brunei: when to start posting for each one, who it matters most to and what to post, for example 'when should my bakery start posting for Chinese New Year?'. Returns the dates from Suara's free posting calendars on trysuara.com (the same files people add to Google, Apple or Outlook), marking dates that can still change. For official public holiday lists in other countries use holiday_calendar. Do not invent dates it doesn't return.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, optional (default a year from the start)

name: festive_calendar
title: Festive posting calendar
